decision_reason: Even the descriptive best does not clear the 25-section timing signal.
labels_used: 40-video development labels, for scoring and setting choice
result_type: Timing-only descriptive development sweep on group-excluded predictions
selection_limit: The leave-one-group checks are sensitivity checks, not outer held-out tests. Models scoring the other groups may have trained on the omitted group.
side_limitation: The compact raw scores do not store player sides for most alternative frames. Timing-complete sections are not fully correct contact-and-side outputs.
